# Secret Santa generator: no emails, couples kept apart, organizer plays too

> Free Secret Santa generator with no sign-up and no emails. Keep couples apart, skip last year's pairs, forbid swaps or force one big loop, and let the organizer play without seeing the results. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
